brief:
Israel shared footage of Palestinians swimming in Gaza to suggest winter storms have not created severe hardships in the territory, according to Al Jazeera English. The video was used to counter reports of difficult conditions during the winter season.

The move comes as Gaza faces documented winter weather challenges affecting civilian populations. Israel's use of the swimming imagery appears aimed at minimizing public concern about humanitarian conditions in the territory.
dek: Israel shared an Al Jazeera video of Palestinians swimming, to suggest winter storms in Gaza can’t be that bad.
title: Israel cites Gaza swimming video to downplay winter hardships
